title: Trump’s Next War? Leaked Plans Reveal Escalation in Cuba and Iran
author: Murtaza Hussain
content:
From [leaked reports](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/u-s-groundwork-potential-
action-cuba-trump/) showing the U.S. Army preparing potential options around
Cuba to the U.S. Navy's strategic tactical shift away from the Iranian
blockade line, Murtaza Hussain and Sarmad Jawad analyze what's driving these
moves--and what Trump's post-midterm foreign policy strategy could look like.

Plus, a look into Iran's updated terminal guidance missile capabilities, the
human toll aboard US naval deployments, and how $100+ oil prices are shaping
negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz.

Then a deep dive into the rise of China in the Trump era as Xi Jinping pays a
state visit for the first time in 10 years.
